classification.PRIMARY_AUTHORITATIVE: Designated official score/feed provider for the sport/league (e.g., 10cric, Betfair, official tournament feed)
classification.SECONDARY_VERIFICATION: Corroborating provider feed used for conflict detection
classification.UNAVAILABLE: Provider is offline or has dropped the fixture
classification.STALE: Provider feed unchanged for > 300 seconds while match is ongoing
classification.CONFLICTING: Provider emits data diverging from primary by > 1 run or status mismatch

outageRules.primaryFinalSecondaryUnavailable: SETTLEMENT_ALLOWED_AFTER_GRACE (Single authoritative provider confirmation is accepted after grace window expiration)
outageRules.primaryFinalSecondaryStale: SETTLEMENT_ALLOWED_AFTER_GRACE (Stale secondary does not block confirmed primary finality once grace window passes)
outageRules.primaryFinalSecondaryLive: BLOCKED_PENDING_RESOLUTION (Material conflict between Live and Final blocks settlement)
outageRules.bothUnavailable: BLOCKED (No settlement permitted without authoritative evidence)
